sql.query: SELECT gc.id,gc.workflowId,gc.contractName,gc.renderedHtml,gc.status,gc.templateVersionNumber,gc.createdDate,w.workflowName,ct.templateName,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown') generatedBy FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=gc.workflowId AND w.tenantId=gc.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_contract_templates ct ON ct.id=gc.templateId AND ct.tenantId=gc.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=gc.generatedByUserId WHERE gc.id=:id AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1
